action.public_message: I'll pay the $50 fine and get out of jail.
action.private_thought: I have ample cash ($1280). Paying $50 fine is cheap and guarantees I leave jail now, allowing me to start moving and potentially collect rent or buy properties. Rolling for doubles has only 1/6 chance; failing would waste a turn and keep me stuck, delaying my strategy to develop the orange set. So I will pay the fine.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
